body.en: The time an algorithm takes depends on how many instructions run as the input size n grows. Simple rules: an algorithm with no loop has constant time complexity, 1; one loop from 1 to n has complexity n; a loop within a loop has complexity n²; if there is a nested loop and also a single loop, the nested loop decides it, n².

narration.en: The time an algorithm takes depends on how many instructions run as the input size n grows. Simple rules: an algorithm with no loop has constant time complexity, 1; one loop from 1 to n has complexity n; a loop within a loop has complexity n²; if there is a nested loop and also a single loop, the nested loop decides it, n².
narration.kn: ಲೂಪ್ ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಸಮಯ ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣತೆ 1 (ಸ್ಥಿರ). ಒಂದು ಲೂಪ್ 1 ರಿಂದ n: n. ಲೂಪ್ ಒಳಗೆ ಲೂಪ್: n². ನೆಸ್ಟೆಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂಟಿ ಲೂಪ್ ಎರಡೂ ಇದ್ದರೆ ನೆಸ್ಟೆಡ್ ಲೂಪ್ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: n².

title.en: On the board: Counting loops to find time complexity

say.en: Count how the number of steps grows with the input size n. Code with no loop takes the same time for any n: constant.
One loop from 1 to n runs n times: linear.
A loop inside a loop runs n times n: quadratic. Bubble, selection and insertion sort all have nested loops.
On a graph, n squared shoots up much faster than n. Doubling n doubles a linear algorithm’s time but makes a quadratic one four times slower.

narration.en: We find the time complexity of code from its loops and compare constant, linear and quadratic growth on a graph.

caption.en: Move n and compare the growth of 1, log n, n, n log n and n². The three simple sorts all grow like n²: double n and the work is about four times.
caption.kn: n ಸರಿಸಿ 1, log n, n, n log n, n² ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ. ಮೂರು ಸರಳ ವಿಂಗಡಣೆಗಳು n² ನಂತೆ: n ದ್ವಿಗುಣವಾದರೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಸುಮಾರು ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪಟ್ಟು.

tryThis.kn: n = 10 ನಂತರ n = 20. n² ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

tryThis.en: Turn on the bubble sort count. Why is it about half of n²?
tryThis.kn: ಬಬಲ್ ಎಣಿಕೆ ಆನ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ಅದು n² ನ ಸುಮಾರು ಅರ್ಧ ಏಕೆ?

tryThis.en: Zoom out to 2500. Which curves now look flat?
tryThis.kn: 2500 ಗೆ ಜೂಮ್ ಔಟ್. ಯಾವ ವಕ್ರಗಳು ಸಮತಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ?

body.en: Bubble, selection and insertion sort each use a nested loop over the list, so all three have time complexity n². For example, bubble sort without an early stop makes (n − 1) + (n − 2) + … + 1 = n(n − 1)/2 comparisons, which grows like n². Doubling n makes such an algorithm about four times slower.
